## Col

| `offset?` | `number \| Partial<Record<Breakpoint, number>>` | `0`     | Number of cells to offset                                                                  |
| `order?`  | `number \| Partial<Record<Breakpoint, number>>` | `-`     | Visual flex `order` only. DOM / Tab / screen-reader order stay as written.                 |
